text: Monitor allocation ID shall be 1; global IDs shall begin at 16 in canonical qualified-key order. Each executed local declaration shall receive a fresh monotonic identity and logical slot charge under RES-008; freed slots shall not permit identity reuse. Return/raise/abandonment shall expire all owning local identities before reuse.
